scope: Independent read-only source and retained raw diagnostics review; no workloads, product/test/dependency edits, benchmark timing or commits.
confirmed_observations: Both unchanged tests fail PLAN version 1 visibility after approved GOAL under the original five-second assertion in the tiny persisted fixture.
Each passive page network log captures the second POST /plan/preview request but no response before failure; request observer measures headers, not end-to-end server phase spans.
Earlier first POST correctly returns 403 and GOAL approval decision returns 200; neither log reports a second POST completed with an application exception.

Current live snapshot shows preview writer in the install/commit/recovery call chain and another thread in event replay/state acquisition; moving frame lines/text are inconsistent, so append JSONL lock acquisition is not identified as the cause.

Baseline live snapshot shows preview and event replay inside repeated memory-adapter initialization; one is at source-projection lock acquisition while another is loading its projection, showing serialization but not an opposing cycle.

Plan preview runs install_plan, advance PLANNED and ensure PLAN as three separate durable commits on the normal new-plan path. Each commit generates all projections, writes a durable transaction marker, replaces every listed document and fsyncs appended events individually before deleting the marker.

Structured projections carry the new capsule generation, so semantically unchanged child entities still produce changed bytes. Plain unchanged request/Markdown files are also rewritten unconditionally.

Every full ProjectUnitOfWork constructs and eagerly reads the source memory adapter under source-projection lock, including task-only/approval/state/event operations that never need memory. This is common baseline work, as are the preview and core transaction functions.

locking_assessment.reason: Preview closes its initial run UoW before memory context; later install/advance/approval UoWs use one owning run, then run state -> per-capsule event lock. The observed replay reader follows the same state -> event order. Event bus publish queues notifications asynchronously and does not synchronously reenter persistence. No waiter holding the inverse event -> state lock or projection -> run lock is established for this preview path.
locking_assessment.retained_limits: Auxiliary global duplicate scans and arbitrary multi-run UoWs remain separate potential cross-run locking surfaces; this review does not prove all locking deadlock-free.

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Avoid eagerly loading source-memory projection for task-only UoWs.
concrete_optimization_candidates.evidence: Identical memory constructor loads every UoW; baseline stack explicitly observes this work.
concrete_optimization_candidates.limit: Requires preserving coherent read view, migration handling, write reload/generation semantics, close/rollback behavior and public protocol; measure actual time before broad redesign.

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Reduce repeated whole-capsule projection rewrites and durable commit count for one preview operation.
concrete_optimization_candidates.evidence: Three distinct commits and full projection replacement are directly confirmed in code, not inferred from stack line.
concrete_optimization_candidates.limit: Generation markers, recovery event ordering, idempotency and authoritative approval boundaries must remain correct; skipping generation changes or removing fsync is not an acceptable shortcut.

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Count repeated filesystem-link/junction traversal checks and event append fsync calls.
concrete_optimization_candidates.evidence: Atomic writes, JSONL operations and layout access repeatedly traverse parents; each event append fsyncs separately.
concrete_optimization_candidates.limit: Their contribution is not measured. Preserve path guards and durable crash recovery; do not claim antivirus/kernel/fs latency cause.

minimal_next_validation: One planned sequential source-bound phase diagnostic with wall/process CPU and call counts for memory UoW initialization/_load, context, install_plan, advance, ensure PLAN and owning lock acquisition waits.
Attribute _documents, _recover, atomic writes (fsync/replace separately), event append/fsync and path guarding without changing assertions, timeout, source or input fixture.
